name: Vendor Services Agreement — Meridian Corp
text:
VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Vendor Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Acme Industries, Inc. ("Company") and Meridian Corp ("Vendor") on July 12, 2024.

1. PAYMENT TERMS
Company shall pay Vendor all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt. Vendor shall not charge late fees on amounts disputed in good faith.

2. AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
This Agreement will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

3. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach upon thirty (30) days written notice, provided the breaching party has not cured such breach during the notice period. Company may terminate for convenience upon ninety (90) days written notice.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party agrees to hold the other's Confidential Information in strict confidence for a period of five (5) years following disclosure, except where required by law.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Vendor's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed two (2) times the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. In no event shall either party be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.

6. DATA PROTECTION
Vendor shall implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect Company data, consistent with industry standards. Vendor will notify Company of any data breach within seventy-two (72) hours of discovery.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All work product created by Vendor specifically for Company under this Agreement shall be deemed work-for-hire and owned exclusively by Company upon full payment.

name: Master Supply Agreement — Ashford Logistics
text:
MASTER SUPPLY AGREEMENT
This Master Supply Agreement is between Acme Industries, Inc. and Ashford Logistics, Ltd., effective July 20, 2024.

1. PAYMENT TERMS
Buyer shall pay all undisputed invoices within forty-five (45) days of receipt.

2. AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
This Agreement renews automatically for one (1) year terms unless cancelled by either party with at least thirty (30) days written notice before the renewal date.

3. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate for material breach after thirty (30) days written notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure. Termination for convenience requires sixty (60) days notice.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
Confidential Information shall be protected for three (3) years after disclosure.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Supplier's liability is capped at the total fees paid in the six (6) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. No consequential damages.

6. DATA PROTECTION
Supplier will follow generally accepted industry security practices and will report any breach affecting Buyer data within forty-eight (48) hours.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All tooling, methods, and pre-existing materials remain the property of the originating party. Buyer receives a non-exclusive license to use deliverables for its internal business purposes.

name: SaaS Subscription Agreement — Nimbus Cloud
text:
SAAS SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT
This SaaS Subscription Agreement is between Acme Industries, Inc. ("Customer") and Nimbus Cloud, Inc. ("Provider"), effective July 27, 2024.

1. PAYMENT TERMS
Subscription fees are invoiced annually in advance and due net thirty (30) days from invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

2. AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
Subscriptions renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless cancelled by Customer at least fifteen (15) days before the renewal date.

3. TERMINATION
Provider may suspend service for non-payment after ten (10) days notice. Customer may terminate for material breach uncured for thirty (30) days. No termination for convenience by Customer.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information using the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential information, but no less than reasonable care, for a period of two (2) years following termination.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Provider's total liability is limited to the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months preceding the claim. Provider disclaims all implied warranties.

6. DATA PROTECTION
Provider will implement industry-standard security measures. Provider will notify Customer of any confirmed data breach without undue delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
Provider retains all rights, title, and interest in and to the Service. Customer retains all rights to its data uploaded to the Service.
